summary: All14 native images and full contact explicitly reviewed at D100. No new broad facial collapse. The combined capacity/feature-loss arm still shows familiar fuzzy neck patches, ragged bands and pitting; b2-051 retains only a partial plausible tab. No convincing clerical collars on validation, new heldouts or fixed unseen. Hats/uncertain age remain in the unrestricted panel. Early checkpoint only, not the final factorial verdict.
limits: Small fixed panel. Contact-level coherence does not establish native photographic quality, identity preservation or distributional diversity. Held-out cases remain excluded from training.
